says: land.ts and the lead scripts it imports (pr/Merge.ts, pr/SweepsProcess.ts, pr/TicketsCli.ts) are not in the .agents typecheck's include list, so pnpm typecheck never reads them; checked alone they carry 35 Effect checks (25 in land.ts, 5 in Merge.ts, 3 in TicketsCli.ts, 2 in SweepsProcess.ts).
proof: git show ffeb20171:.agents/tsconfig.json has no land.ts in its include list, which starts at line 42; a tsc run on the head's land.ts alone, with the same config and node types resolved, reports those 35 effect(...) diagnostics and no ordinary type error; importing land.ts from a checked law brings the same diagnostics into pnpm typecheck.
cost: The merge route's code gets no typecheck gate. This round's first admin route fix read the Alerts service outside its provide, a type error that only a check of land.ts reached.
